rationale.conceptual: Standard DFT calculation of cubic perovskite using PBE functional, with standard post-processing of elastic constants and Debye temperature. No novel theoretical methods.
rationale.execution: Multi-step DFT workflow requiring sequential geometry optimization, band structure calculation, elastic constants via stress-strain method (multiple deformed structures), and final property aggregation; involves file I/O and orchestration between Quantum ESPRESSO runs.

difficulty.reasoning: The paper presents a standard DFT study of cubic KCaF3 using PBE functional. Reproducing the results requires running several sequential Quantum ESPRESSO calculations (geometry optimization, band structure, elastic constants) and post-processing with known formulas. The method is well-established, and the system is tiny, making the conceptual challenge low but the execution moderately complex due to multi-stage orchestration.

compute_estimate.reasoning: Tiny unit cell (5 atoms) with moderate 10x10x10 k-point grid and 380 eV cutoff; runs comfortably on a single CPU core with <4 GB memory and trivial I/O.
